answer: Each identity locks 20 POA in a vault for 90 days and must leave its home island each quarter on a distinct flight or train ticket over 200 km, with an operator-signed boarding beacon, hashed on-chain. A reused ticket slashes both deposits, so each extra fake needs another real ticket averaging 60 dollars: 100 fakes cost 6,000 dollars and 2,000 POA locked per quarter, versus one ticket and 20 POA per honest user; bulk buying from one source triples manual review. Hashes and beacon times sit on-chain for verifiers. Those unable to travel pay a 40 POA deposit plus a quarterly live video check.
